I replied to Ilse in our direct message to confirm I have the note: the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork cutoff is now 7 July. I told them it stays between us.

- **Where the note lives:** only in that direct message. I didn't save it to GBrain, because GBrain is shared across sources and other members could see it there. For the same reason I didn't save it to the bot's own memory, which serves every member.
- **The date:** it's 14 Oct 2026, so 7 July this year has already passed. I said I'm taking it as 7 July 2027 and asked Ilse to correct me if they meant something else.
- **GBrain:** I searched it first and found nothing about a paperwork cutoff for this account. That isn't proof there's no record, because search was running keyword-only.

I took no other action, since Ilse said none was needed.
